_comment: Offline advisory feed, no network at check time. Every entry needs id, series, module, published, severity and an https source url (entries without one are ignored). Optional: fixed_build (YYYY-MM-DD of the first fixed build; when absent, 'published' is used), summary, example:true (ignored by the check). Add a series to reviewed_series only after checking it against NVD/vendor advisories. Verified 2026-11-03 against the NVD pages and the CCB Belgium advisory #2025-47 listed in each url/sources. NVD records the affected versions as '15.0' and '<=17.0' and gives no fixed build, hence no fixed_build here. Odoo 18.0: no Odoo-core CVE found in the OpenCVE vendor listing on that date (not proof of absence).

advisories.summary: Improper access control in auth_oauth: an internal user could export the OAuth tokens of other users.
Improper access control in mail: a remote authenticated attacker could extract sensitive information through an oracle-style (yes/no) attack.
